title: Marketing and Communications Officer
company: Get Staffed Online Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing and Communications Officer

Hours of Work: Up to 37 hours per week; Some evening and weekend work may be necessary to carry out the duties of this post

Salary: £31,063 - £32,094 (FTE)

Term of Employment: Fixed Term (18 months)

Location: Rotherham

The Marketing and Communications Officer will play an instrumental role in promoting all strands of the Moving Rotherham initiative and will lead on designing, delivering, and evaluating innovative marketing strategies to communicate project impact, grow audiences, and encourage active participation across diverse communities in Rotherham.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

1. Marketing Strategy and Brand Management:
- Devising and monitoring campaign strategies and individual project plans within defined budgets.
- Implementing an effective and engaging brand identity across all programme strands.
- Evaluating all marketing campaigns to ensure audience targets and financial targets are met.

2. Digital Communications and Content Creation:
- Managing and updating the Moving Rotherham website and digital platforms.
- Planning and creating engaging social media content across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
- Producing and monitoring targeted e-newsletters.
- Supporting project documentation and evaluation commissioning film and photography.

3. Media Relations and Event Promotion:
- Serving as the key point of contact for media enquiries across local, regional, and national print, broadcast, and online media.
- Identifying opportunities with strategic networks to secure media coverage.
- Creating and implementing imaginative communications for events, festivals, and community roadshows.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration and Compliance:
- Building strong relationships with delivery partners, website providers, designers, and evaluation teams.
- Assisting members of the public via telephone and in person in a courteous manner.
- Ensuring compliance with Data Protection Act / GDPR guidelines, as well as organisational policies on Equality, Health and Safety, Corporate Image, and Confidentiality.

Our client is the lead body for supporting, developing and promoting the Voluntary and Community Sector (VCS) in the Rotherham Borough. Their role is to facilitate effective action to bring about positive change in the lives of individuals and communities in the local area.

To apply for this role, please send in your CV and a covering letter (outlining your skills and experience in relation to this role).

Closing date for applications is 5:00pm on Monday, 23rd of November.

Interviews are likely to be held on Friday, 4th of December at The Spectrum. Our client will, however, review applications as they are submitted and may bring candidates forward for an interview (with reasonable notice) at any time. They may also close this vacancy early if sufficient applications have been received.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator
Location: Rotherham
Salary: £27,000 to £30,000
Contract: Temporary to Permanent
Working pattern: Hybrid working after training, with three days per week in the office

Elevation Recruitment Group is working with a business in Rotherham to recruit a Payroll Administrator on a temporary-to-permanent basis. This is a great opportunity for an experienced payroll professional to join an established team, take responsibility for accurate payroll processing and develop their skills within a supportive working environment.

The role offers hybrid working following training, alongside a competitive benefits package and opportunities for salary progression.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing end-to-end UK payroll, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time.
- Completing pre-payroll and post-payroll checks, including monthly payroll reconciliations.
- Processing statutory payments, deductions and pension contributions.
- Preparing and submitting HMRC Real Time Information returns and other statutory documentation.
- Maintaining accurate employee records and handling sensitive payroll information confidentially.
- Investigating payroll discrepancies and resolving employee queries promptly.
- Supporting the preparation of P60s, P11 Ds and other payroll-related documentation.
- Ensuring payroll activities comply with current legislation, HMRC requirements and GDPR.
- Assisting with payroll audits and maintaining high standards of data accuracy.

To be successful in this Payroll Administrator role, you will have:
- Previous experience processing UK payroll from start to finish, with minimal supervision.
- Experience using payroll software such as Sage, with the ability to learn new systems.
- A good working knowledge of HMRC submissions, RTI and pension auto-enrolment.
- Strong Excel skills, including formulas, sorting and filtering data, and pivot tables.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work to strict monthly deadlines.
- A professional approach to handling confidential employee information.
- Good communication skills and the ability to resolve payroll queries effectively.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £27,000 to £30,000.
- Temporary-to-permanent opportunity.
- Hybrid working after training
- Enhanced company sick pay.
- Pension scheme
- On-site parking

If you are an experienced payroll professional looking for your next opportunity in Rotherham, this could be an excellent fit. Apply today or contact Elevation Recruitment Group for further information.

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
W are recruiting an experienced Payroll/Accounts Assistant for a business based in Rotherham.

Full time or part time hours considered.
- A well-established company with an excellent reputation, positive culture and good staff retention.
- Strong order book and profitable!
- A knowledgeable, supportive finance team.
- Regular opportunities to learn and develop.
- 6% matched pension 25 days holiday

THE JOB:

Reporting to the Payroll Manager, duties to include but not limited:
- Processing payroll (including shift patters, attendance bonus, supplements etc) for c 400 employees, including all associated administration.
- Administration of the time and attendance system.
- Administration of staff holidays and sickness.
- Dealing with payroll queries.
- Other ad hoc duties within the finance team as required.

THE PERSON:
- Payroll experience is essential.
- The ability to work on your own initiative as well as part of a team is required.
- Good IT skills are required.
- A flexible and adaptable approach is essential.
- Most importantly, we are looking for someone who is reliable, proactive and keen to develop in a varied finance role.
